milestones._percentNote: Percentages are rounded to 2dp for readability; residual rounding is carried on the largest milestone so each column sums to exactly 100.00. Use the amount fields, not the percentages, for posting.

_dataQualityFindings.finding: The workbook's 'Invoicing Schedule' totals AED 116,052,422 ex-VAT against a stated TCV of AED 116,051,000 - a variance of AED 1,422 arising from AED/USD conversion rounding.
_dataQualityFindings.resolutionApplied: amountExcludingTaxReconciled reduces M6/INV-007 by AED 1,422 so the schedule ties exactly to the contractual TCV. amountExcludingTaxAsAnalysed retains the original figure.
_dataQualityFindings.actionRequired: Confirm the precise AED package breakdown with Daypop and agree which package absorbs the rounding before INV-005 to INV-007 are raised.

_dataQualityFindings.finding: The workbook's 'Delivery Milestones' sheet '% of POB value' column sums to 112.3%, and M0 is stated as 24.7% where the invoice value implies 12.3% of TCV (or 25.4% of POB-2).
_dataQualityFindings.resolutionApplied: Milestone weights in this payload are derived from invoice values, which reconcile to 100.00% of the transaction price. The original figures are retained as sourcePercentOfPobValue for traceability.
_dataQualityFindings.actionRequired: Correct the source workbook column so it states a consistent basis.

_dataQualityFindings.finding: The per-milestone split between POB-1 and POB-2 is not stated in the source analysis for M1-M6.
_dataQualityFindings.resolutionApplied: M0 is allocated 100% to POB-2 (licence delivery). M1-M6 are split pro-rata on residual POB value: POB-1 58.79% / POB-2 41.21%. Rounding differences are absorbed in M6 so each POB ties exactly to its allocated transaction price.
_dataQualityFindings.actionRequired: Replace with the actual per-package P&I / Backbone split from Commercial Proposal Appendix B before this drives revenue postings. This split determines revenue by POB in every period and must not go live unconfirmed.

_dataQualityFindings.finding: INV-007 / M6 is dated May 2026, after the contract expiry of 31 March 2026.
_dataQualityFindings.actionRequired: Confirm the delivery and billing date with the contract manager, or process a contract extension in D365 so the billing schedule line does not fall outside the contract period and fail validation.
